top.title: Viral James Harden clip sums up Cavs’ woes in blowout vs. Hornets
top.description: Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images Viral James Harden clip sums up Cavs’ woes in blowout vs. Hornets appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . James Harden has not even been close to being at his best to start the 2026-27 season for the Cleveland Cavaliers . Entering play on Monday against the Charlotte Hornets, Harden’s been averaging just 15.7 points, 5.0 rebounds, and 5.8 assists per game on 37/36/84 shooting splits — failing to be the impactful superstar floor general he’s been for the past 14 years or so. The Cavs’ loss to the Hornets has to be a wake-up call for this veteran team that has championship aspirations. In particular, Harden has to be better. Their 124-112 loss to Charlotte does not fall solely on the 37-year-old guard’s shoulders. But he did not help matters whatsoever with his lethargic play. One play from Harden, in particular, went viral on social media showcasing his lack of effort both on the glass and on the defensive end. After Grayson Allen missed a three, Harden went up for a board and got outjumped by Hornets big man Ryan Kalkbrenner — an understandable defeat on the glass. But Harden did not close out on his man after Kalkbrenner kicked the ball out to a wide-open Sion James from three. The Cavs star would then undercut Allen, leading to a foul called on the 37-year-old. James Harden. Yikes. pic.twitter.com/Z08ZE2EQIg — Legion Hoops (@LegionHoops) November 10, 2026 Harden, as one of the veteran leaders of this Cavs team, simply cannot be caught napping like this even in a regular season tilt against a Hornets team that’s been struggling to start the 2026-27 season. As one could see, the Cavs were already down by 16 points in the third quarter of Monday’s contest, and yet Harden’s lack of effort was in full display. Cavs head coach Kenny Atkinson said after the game that the Hornets simply gave more effort and played with more energy. This viral Harden clip is the perfect encapsulation of what went wrong for Cleveland in a 12-point loss that wasn’t as close as the final score would indicate. top.description: Dale Zanine-Imagn Images Luka Doncic told Atlanta Hawks fans on Monday night that they wish they had drafted him. He made this comment during a 124-114 victory for the Los Angeles Lakers at State Farm Arena. The exchange happened right in front of the courtside seats where fans were sitting. A video of the moment was shared online by @RKessler23 on the Threads platform. Doncic reminded the crowd that Atlanta once held the rights to his future before trading them away. He spoke to them with a smile after the game ended. The 2018 NBA Draft is the source of this long-standing pain for the franchise. Atlanta picked Doncic third overall but sent him to Dallas in a deal that brought Trae Young to the Hawks. Young now plays in Washington alongside Anthony Davis. The Court-Side Exchange Doncic started the conversation by asking the fans if they regret their choice. According to a New York Post report, he said, “You all wish you would have had me. You all wish, huh?” One fan replied by claiming Atlanta did have him. Another fan disagreed immediately and insisted, “No we don’t, I’ve never wanted you.” The crowd laughed as the argument continued in front of the cameras. One fan in the group admitted the truth to the star player. That person said, “I wish we did, I do.” Doncic used this moment to drive the point home even further. He told the fan, “You know you could have had me.” The person recording the video acknowledged this fact through laughter while the game ended. A Historic Night on the Floor Doncic backed up his trash talk with a dominant performance on the court. He scored 32 points, handed out 10 assists, and grabbed eight rebounds in the win. He also recorded five steals and two blocks during the game. This stat line made him the first player in Lakers history to reach these numbers in multiple games. Not even Magic Johnson or Kareem Abdul-Jabbar achieved this feat twice while wearing the purple and gold. Walker Kessler, the new center for the Lakers, watched this display closely. He has seen enough of Doncic’s play to make a bold statement about his teammate. Kessler declared, “He’s the best player in the league” following the victory over the Hawks. This comment came just 12 games into the NBA season for the new roster. Numbers That Speak Louder Doncic is currently leading the entire NBA in scoring with an average of 40.1 points per game. top.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Two teams in desperate need of a win needed a shootout to determine who would prevail Monday night, and it was the San Jose Sharks getting the 3-2 victory and pushing the New York Islanders losing streak to four games (0-2-2). For the second straight contest, the Islanders could not hold a lead as the Sharks rallied to end their five-game skid. The tying goal was a bad break for New York as Tyler Toffoli’s shot doinked in off Adam Pelech ’s head. When it rains, it pours. On top of that, it took eight rounds of shootout hockey to determine the winner, and Sharks rookie Ivar Stenberg, who also scored San Jose’s first goal, finally got one past Ilya Sorokin , who played his usual strong game, albeit just for one point. Sorokin stopped 36 shots, but he was matched by Yaroslav Askarov, who made 29 saves in 65 minutes and denied the Islanders in all eight shootout rounds. top.title: AS Roma set key condition to sign out-of-favour Barcelona defender in January
top.description: AS Roma set key condition to sign out-of-favour Barcelona defender in January It is known that Barcelona are considering the possibility of selling Alejandro Balde during the January transfer window, with AS Roma exploring a potential deal for the left-back as they look to generate funds for squad reinforcements. On that note, according to Spanish publication SPORT , the Italian club are examining a paid loan with an obligation to buy that would become conditional on qualification for next season’s Champions League. Balde’s situation has attracted attention because Barcelona are assessing their options in the transfer market, with signing a central defender among Flick’s priorities. However, a potential departure is far from straightforward given the Catalan club’s €40 million valuation of the academy graduate. Roma consider conditional purchase option for Balde Roma’s proposed formula is designed to make the operation financially manageable. AS Roma are interested in signing Alejandro Balde. (Photo by Pedro Salado/Getty Images) Rather than paying Barcelona’s full asking price immediately, the Serie A side would initially secure Balde’s services on loan before triggering a purchase obligation if they qualify for the Champions League. Such an arrangement would also give Barcelona an opportunity to generate revenue through a future permanent transfer. However, the financial demands remain a significant obstacle, as Barcelona value the defender highly, meaning Roma would need to commit considerable resources to complete the operation in January itself. Juventus and Premier League clubs join the race Notably, Roma are not the only club monitoring Balde’s availability, as Juventus have also been following the defender, with their interest potentially influenced by uncertainty surrounding Andrea Cambiaso’s future in Turin. The competition extends to England , where Liverpool, Aston Villa, Manchester United, Manchester City and Tottenham have all been linked with the Barcelona full-back. Monaco are another potential destination. Barcelona value Alejandro Balde at €40 million. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) However, the financial structure of a potential transfer could determine which clubs remain realistic candidates. Barcelona value Balde at around €40 million and would prefer a permanent sale, although they are prepared to consider a loan arrangement that guarantees future income. Barcelona to use Balde’s departure to fund January signing Understandably, Balde’s possible departure is also connected to Barcelona’s recruitment plans. It is known that Flick wants additional defensive reinforcement, particularly a left-footed centre-back who could strengthen his options during the second half of the season. Hence, selling an academy graduate would provide Barcelona with an opportunity to generate transfer income while potentially creating additional room within their wage structure.

top.title: This Matthew Stafford trade proposal is stupid
top.description: (Photo by Patrick Smith/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Minnesota Vikings have such a stark contrast between their elite defense and their tremendous issues at quarterback that Rams fans couldn’t expect L.A. to go through one rough patch without hearing Matthew Stafford trade speculation. The Vikings need a quarterback, Kevin O’Connell used to be Sean McVay’s offensive coordinator, and the Rams are flirting with disaster as Puka Nacua joins the walking wounded. Well, sorry if you were waiting for another blockbuster trade. The Los Angeles Rams are not going to trade Matthew Stafford ahead of the NFL trade deadline on Tuesday. It’s an idea that makes little to no sense for the Rams, prompted by an especially bad quarterback performance during a standalone game on Monday night. Stafford isn’t having his best season and Los Angeles isn’t even guaranteed a playoff spot at this point, but nothing this franchise has done would indicate they’re interested in such a hard reset. That hasn’t stopped X from speculating about “why it makes sense” anyway. STAFFORD TRADE POTENTIAL This entire thought came to be during Monday Night Football in Week 9, which saw the Minnesota Vikings fall to the Buffalo Bills 23-6 largely because Carson Wentz played one of the worst games in recent memory: 8-of-25, 81 yards, 2 interceptions, a lost fumble on a backwards pass. He was terrible, the Vikings offense wasted a typically stellar effort by their defense and now a team that was once 6-0 has lost consecutive games and is spiraling offensively. There is no hope coming in the form of Kyler Murray, whose “serviceable” stats overstate how limited he is as a passer and holding back the offense by not being able to throw in the middle of the field and isn’t as fast as he used to be. ESPN’s entire broadcast team, from Joe Buck and Troy Aikman in the booth to Scott Van Pelt during SportsCenter after the game openly hypothesized about Minnesota making a move for a quarterback so as not to waste an incredible season from Brian Flores’s defense. top.title: 'Grim day brings the R-word into focus'
top.description: [BBC] Saturday's game at Cardiff ended with a mass brawl as the players, including some of Burnley's substitutes, clashed on the pitch. They completely lost their cool, it was embarrassing and will probably result in an FA charge and possibly a club fine. Having just watched their side capitulate from 4-1 up to 5-4 down inside the final half an hour, the supporters who travelled to Cardiff, and those following back home, were then subjected to that reaction. The lack of discipline and respect shown during those final few moments of the game was a dreadful look on a grim day for the club. The contrast from this Burnley side to the one that won promotion under Scott Parker could not be greater, and it's not just about the numbers. Although, the numbers are worth looking at. Just 16 goals conceded during that promotion season. It's now 31 goals against this time round already. They've taken the lead in 10 of their 15 league games and only won once. They've lost 23 points from winning positions. Burnley have gone from having a team that was relatable and likeable, that ran and worked hard and represented the club, to one that has forgotten how to win and has no way of dealing with adversity. The squad looks bloated, poorly balanced and far too injury-prone and with too many who probably don't want to be there. It's been 26 years since Burnley last played outside England's top two divisions. Could the club cope with a relegation to League One? top.title: UFC chief declines Trump’s White House job offer
top.description: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief Dana White turned down President Donald Trump’s — apparently jovial — offer of a job as press secretary in a surprise appearance at the White House on Monday. Trump stunned the world by saying on social media on Saturday that he had asked White to take on the high-profile post — but a day later the 80-year-old president said he was “only kidding.” The 57-year-old cage fighting boss visited the White House on Monday, and Trump brought him out for a chaotic news conference in the James Brady Briefing Room. “So let me ask you the big question. Would you like to be press secretary of the United States of America? Or do you just want to stay with this ridiculous UFC? Huh?” Trump said. “Thank you for the offer, sir — for the offer, I have no, no — I do not want to be in politics,” White replied. Trump smiled and headed out of the room, saying: “I am devastated to hear this. Goodbye, everybody.” The press secretary’s post has been been vacant since Katie Zacharia left on October 16 after less than a week in the post. Her combative predecessor Karoline Leavitt left in August after a year and a half in the job. Trump’s announcement that he had offered the high-profile job to “violent Fighter and Warrior” White had sparked speculation that he was ready for a aggressive stance after the Republican Party’s stunning midterm elections defeat. White is a long-time friend of the president and helped host a massive UFC match on the White House lawn earlier this year. But there was also some skepticism about the president’s announcement, and Trump said Sunday night that he had been joking. – ‘Beat the hell out of you’ – Leading out White to the podium on Monday, Trump said he had been “having a little fun.” “He’s a great guy,” Trump told the room full of reporters. “The only problem is he’ll talk for a little while and then he’s going to beat the hell out of you.” Standing at the lectern and wearing a black t-shirt and jacket, White looked like he might be more comfortable in the octagon — the ring used for UFC fights. “I’ve always wanted to do this. Who has the first question?” he joked — before quickliy adding: “I have zero political aspirations.” White added that “the last 24 hours of my life has been insane” since Trump made the announcement. Asked by a journalist to confirm he had said no to the job, White added: “I don’t tell the president ‘no’ to anything… I didn’t want to be disrespectful and say anything until he said something first.” Trump then took a series of questions on more weighty matters, from the Iran and Ukraine wars to the possible impeachment of Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth and a spy scandal engulfing Nvidia boss Jensen Huang. top.description: Real Madrid summer signing threatening Lamine Yamal in key statistical battle It is a known fact that Real Madrid summer signing Yan Diomande is emerging as a serious attacking option for Jose Mourinho, with his impressive dribbling statistics highlighting the growing competition for Vinicius Jr.’s place in the starting XI. According to Diario AS , the Ivorian’s latest performance against Valencia at Mestalla strengthened his position among La Liga’s most effective dribblers. As such, he has completed 43 successful dribbles in the competition, placing him second behind Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal, who leads with 57. More importantly for Real Madrid, Diomande has nearly doubled Vinicius’ tally while establishing himself as one of the team’s most dangerous players in one-on-one situations. Diomande challenges Yamal for La Liga’s dribbling crown Although Yamal leads the overall rankings, Diomande boasts a better frequency of successful dribbles. The Real Madrid forward completes one every 20 minutes, compared with the Barcelona youngster’s average of one every 23 minutes. Diomande has a better dribbling rate than any Real Madrid player. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) His six successful dribbles against Valencia were his third-best return of the season and his highest tally in an away La Liga fixture. Meanwhile, Diomande has also become Real Madrid’s leading dribbler. Including the Champions League, only Kylian Mbappe has completed more successful dribbles than the Ivorian, recording 53 compared with Diomande’s 52. The difference becomes even more impressive when playing time is considered, as Mbappe required 541 additional minutes to reach his total. Vinicius is an established attacking figure, but the Ivorian’s performances are making it increasingly difficult to overlook his contribution. top.title: Steven Gerrard urges Cole Palmer and Thomas Tuchel to resolve England dispute
top.description: Steven Gerrard urges Cole Palmer and Thomas Tuchel to resolve England dispute Steven Gerrard has called for Cole Palmer and Thomas Tuchel to sort their differences and believes the Chelsea midfielder should 'definitely' be in the England squad. Palmer was a notable omission from Thomas Tuchel's squad for the upcoming UEFA Nations League games against Croatia and Spain. The 24-year-old was not selected for the 2026 World Cup in the summer, and pulled out of September's squad with fitness concerns. Tuchel has criticised Palmer for a lack of availability with England, and said this month that he has not had enough opportunities to impress with the national side. Gerrard was asked about Palmer's latest absence on The Overlap Daily , and said the pair need to solve their issues. He said Palmer's talent deserves a place in the squad and that the dup can both 'help each other'. "The Cole Palmer one confuses me. I understand both sides of this because he wasn't selected for the World Cup. Then he goes back to Cole afterwards," Gerrard said. "I think a little bit of ego's kicked in on Cole's side, where he's gone: 'I'm carrying a little bit of a niggle. I never got picked for the World Cup. I'm probably not going to play ahead of [Morgan] Rogers and [Jude] Bellingham in these games. I'm just going to rest it.' "It came out that he was managing his load and stuff. I don't think that was the right thing to do. I think he should have joined up with England and really tried to give that a go to prove the England staff wrong for not picking him for the World Cup. "So, he doesn't go to that one in September, there's no international break in October, and now we're in November and he doesn't get selected again. Thomas has remembered him dropping out. There's a bit of an underlying issue here. "I think they need to have a one-to-one and have a coffee, because I think they can both help each other. I think Cole Palmer should definitely be in the England squad and he should be pushing for minutes in the team. That's what I see in a Chelsea shirt."

top.title: How Bayern Munich got Michael Olise
top.description: Photo by F. Noever/FC Bayern via Getty Images | FC Bayern via Getty Images Bayern Munich winger Michael Olise is one of the biggest revelations in world football. Arriving from Crystal Palace, the 24-year-old hit the ground running and hasn’t looked back since. Max Eberl spoke to Säbener 51 (Bayern’s in-house publication) about how the Bavarians pounced on the deal. “He had a somewhat unsettled career path, having attended several academies in England. But that kind of background doesn’t necessarily have to be a red flag — overcoming adversity can also shape a player,” Eberl said (as captured by X account @iMiaSanMia ). “To get to know a footballer, most of all, you need to speak to people who have known him as either a teammate or an opponent.” The 53-year-old revealed that the club had connections to then-Palace manager Oliver Glasner through sporting director Christoph Freund, a fellow Austrian. “In Michael’s case, we had the advantage that Oliver G lasner was his coach at Crystal Palace at the time, and our sporting director, Christoph Freund, knows Glasner very we ll,” Eberl continued. “When a coach says, ‘Of course, take him, take him,’ you start to wonder. But Glasner said, ‘He still has a lot to learn—and we need him.’ That told us how highly he valued Michael. And then there were the conversations wit h Michael himself. Talking football with him is a real pleasure. ” Eberl went on to say that Olise is a player he and Bayern felt would fit Vincent Kompany’s system, and that his rapid development is down to the club staff. “Honestly, we knew we were signing a very good left-footed winger who fits the Bayern mold,” Eberl said. “But the fact that he would turn out to be this exceptional… The transfer fee was predictable because of the release clause. His development is also down to the en vironment and the team around him.” Since then, Olise’s market value has skyrocketed into nine figures, cementing his status as one of the most sought-after right wingers in Europe. nigeria.title: UFC chief declines Trump’s White House job offer
nigeria.description: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) chief Dana White turned down President Donald Trump’s — apparently jovial — offer of a job as press secretary in a surprise appearance at the White House on Monday. Trump stunned the world by saying on social media on Saturday that he had asked White to take on the high-profile post — but a day later the 80-year-old president said he was “only kidding.” The 57-year-old cage fighting boss visited the White House on Monday, and Trump brought him out for a chaotic news conference in the James Brady Briefing Room. “So let me ask you the big question. Would you like to be press secretary of the United States of America? Or do you just want to stay with this ridiculous UFC? Huh?” Trump said. “Thank you for the offer, sir — for the offer, I have no, no — I do not want to be in politics,” White replied. Trump smiled and headed out of the room, saying: “I am devastated to hear this. Goodbye, everybody.” The press secretary’s post has been been vacant since Katie Zacharia left on October 16 after less than a week in the post. Her combative predecessor Karoline Leavitt left in August after a year and a half in the job. Trump’s announcement that he had offered the high-profile job to “violent Fighter and Warrior” White had sparked speculation that he was ready for a aggressive stance after the Republican Party’s stunning midterm elections defeat. White is a long-time friend of the president and helped host a massive UFC match on the White House lawn earlier this year. But there was also some skepticism about the president’s announcement, and Trump said Sunday night that he had been joking. – ‘Beat the hell out of you’ – Leading out White to the podium on Monday, Trump said he had been “having a little fun.” “He’s a great guy,” Trump told the room full of reporters. “The only problem is he’ll talk for a little while and then he’s going to beat the hell out of you.” Standing at the lectern and wearing a black t-shirt and jacket, White looked like he might be more comfortable in the octagon — the ring used for UFC fights. “I’ve always wanted to do this. Who has the first question?” he joked — before quickliy adding: “I have zero political aspirations.” White added that “the last 24 hours of my life has been insane” since Trump made the announcement. Asked by a journalist to confirm he had said no to the job, White added: “I don’t tell the president ‘no’ to anything… I didn’t want to be disrespectful and say anything until he said something first.” Trump then took a series of questions on more weighty matters, from the Iran and Ukraine wars to the possible impeachment of Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth and a spy scandal engulfing Nvidia boss Jensen Huang. nigeria.title: N10m reward to motivate FCT councillors, not vote buying — APC chair defends Wike
nigeria.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye The National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress, Nentawe Yilwatda, has defended the N10 million reward promised by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, to councillors who deliver their wards for President Bola Tinubu and other APC candidates in the 2027 general elections. Speaking on Channels Television’s Politics Today, on Monday, Yilwatda said the money was intended to motivate councillors and would be paid after the election, once the result had been established. “He was speaking to the FCT councillors in the forum, and I’m sure it’s addressing something about 62 or 60-something councillors in the FCT,” he said. Asked whether the offer amounted to voter inducement, Yilwatda rejected the suggestion, arguing that political parties routinely provide funds for mobilisation. “Which political party doesn’t release money for mobilisation? Which political party? So, tell me one. No, it’s not for votes. The same reward for you to deliver Tinubu in your ward,” he said. Yilwatda compared the offer to rewarding students for academic achievement but maintained that the timing of the payment was significant. “The money is not given before the election. It doesn’t matter? No, it matters. It matters because if the money is given after the election has been concluded and the winner has been declared and there’s nothing at stake again—if the court has proven and all the legal rules have been followed—that you legally deliver your ward by giving you N10 million,” he said. Asked again whether he considered the offer of vote buying, Yilwatda replied authoritatively: “Never.” Wike made the pledge at a political meeting in Kwali Area Council, promising N10 million to each councillor who delivers their ward for Tinubu and the APC in 2027. Asked whether the APC would return Godswill Akpabio as Senate President if he wins re-election, Yilwatda said the decision would rest with senators. “Let’s wait for the election first. I don’t have anybody in mind. The Senate will determine who they want to make the Senate President,” he said. On reports of electoral violence ahead of the 2027 general elections, Yilwatda said he sympathised with anyone injured and said the APC supported free and fair elections. “If anybody is injured by anybody across the country, I’m sure it shouldn’t be by APC supporters. I pity anybody who is being injured, and I sympathise with them. Our party stands for free and fair elections,” he said. nigeria.title: Trump sees ‘positive momentum’ on Iran after Qatar PM talks
nigeria.description: US President Donald Trump said on Monday there was momentum toward ending the war with Iran, as he declared that the country “militarily, is effectively over,” but kept open the possibility of new strikes. Trump met at the White House with Qatar Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani — a key mediator in the Iran war. It was his first meeting with a foreign leader since his party’s massive losses in the midterm elections. Trump later posted on Truth Social that the two leaders had “an excellent conversation” and that “much was discussed with respect to the Islamic Republic of Iran.” In the weeks leading up to the midterms, there was widespread speculation that US strikes against Iran would resume soon after. However, Trump has talked down resuming the conflict while leaving the door open to further strikes — a position he reiterated Monday at a White House press briefing. “Iran, militarily, is effectively over. We’re just keeping it the status quo,” Trump told reporters. “But if we do have to go back in, we are locked and loaded, and ready to go.” In his social post on Monday, Trump said that he believed further strikes were “quite unlikely” given that key US allies in the Gulf “would prefer the status quo.” “We are seeing positive momentum toward an end to this Conflict, and will ensure that America’s interests are at all times protected,” Trump said. – ‘Imaginary talks’ – Iranian officials meanwhile expressed defiance at the continued pressure from Washington. The Islamic republic’s top security chief, Mohsen Rezai, wrote on X late Monday that the US “flails like a desperate gambler,” telling Washington to “fold your hand. Stop manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks.” Earlier, Tehran’s top negotiator Mahammad Bagher Ghalibaf claimed on X that Israel was pushing the US deeper into conflict, adding that “unless Washington drops the ‘Israel First’ mindset, America and its allies are headed straight for a dark age.” On the ground in Iran, strikes — which have not been publicly acknowledged by the US military — are continuing, according to Iranian authorities. The island of Qeshm, located in the Strait of Hormuz, was targeted overnight from Sunday to Monday, the provincial deputy governor stated on state television. Trump has acknowledged that the highly unpopular war with Iran was at least partially responsible for the Republicans’ defeat, not least because it has contributed to rising prices in the US economy. nigeria.title: I give kudos to people who sent me to jail; it’s like school – Orji Kalu
nigeria.description: Senator representing Abia North, Orji Kalu, has praised those responsible for his imprisonment, saying the six months he spent behind bars gave him valuable life lessons and made him a more humble person. Kalu said rather than regret his incarceration, he considers it an experience that changed his understanding of life and helped him develop a different outlook. The former Abia State governor made the remarks during an interview on Arise Television on Monday. Explaining why he was grateful for the experience, Kalu said, “It made me more humble. It made me to realise that life is not the same thing I used to think about. So I’m very grateful to God I was there.” He added, “And I gave kudos to people that sent me there because it’s like going to school. And I graduated there, and I’m very happy I went there.” Kalu was convicted by a Federal High Court in Lagos in December 2019 on a 39-count charge and sentenced to 12 years’ imprisonment. However, the Supreme Court overturned the conviction on May 8, 2020, ruling that the trial judge, Mohammed Idris, lacked jurisdiction to deliver the judgment after his elevation to the Court of Appeal. The apex court ordered a fresh trial, and Kalu was released from Kuje Correctional Centre after spending approximately six months in custody. Asked whether he believed the conviction was justified, the senator disagreed but said he did not wish to dwell on the matter. “No, it wasn’t the right thing to do. But I don’t like to discuss this because the judge had his reasons. When the judge did it, I praised him. I support all his decisions,” he said. Kalu also acknowledged that the judiciary had its challenges but maintained that some judges remained committed to dispensing justice. He advised Nigerians dissatisfied with rulings of lower courts to pursue appeals rather than publicly condemn judicial decisions. According to him, taking cases to higher courts gives litigants another opportunity to obtain justice, as more judges are involved in reviewing the decisions. nigeria.title: Atiku congratulates Nigerian athletes on three Dakar Youth Olympic gold medals
nigeria.description: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has congratulated Nigerian athletes following their historic performance at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, where Team Nigeria won three gold medals in athletics. Atiku, in a post on his X account on Tuesday, particularly celebrated Rosemary Nwankwo, Gift Bright and Praise Ugoh for their victories in the women’s 100 metres, men’s 100 metres and women’s 400 metres events, respectively. He described the athletes’ performance as historic, noting that Nwankwo and Bright won the women’s and men’s 100 metres titles on the same day, marking the first time Nigeria had recorded such a double at the Youth Olympic Games. He also congratulated Ugoh for winning the women’s 400 metres title in her first final over the distance at the competition, becoming the first Nigerian to claim the event’s gold medal at the Games. “These young Nigerians have shown the world what discipline, courage and self-belief can achieve. Their success is a reminder that our nation’s greatest wealth lies in her youth, and that when we invest in their talent, they will raise our flag on every stage,” Atiku said. The former vice-president pledged to continue advocating support for young Nigerians, particularly in providing facilities and opportunities for talented individuals to excel. He also congratulated the athletes’ coaches and families, describing their achievements as a source of pride for the country. nigeria.title: Petrol, Food Prices Rise Further As Iran War Worsens El Niño Impact Globally — UN
nigeria.description: El Niño disrupts global weather patterns, bringing heavy rain to some regions and drought to others, and spiking food and fuel prices, a situation worsened by the ongoing war in Iran, according to the Chief Economist at the United Nations’ Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), Maximo Torero. Speaking with AFP, Torero said both rain and drought can impact harvests and production of crops for animal feed. Floods can be particularly devastating, destroying stored food and damaging the infrastructure and transportation needed to get products to market. All these elements can push up prices, and the impacts “can emerge well before harvests are completed,” he said. “Markets react to expectations of future shortages and uncertainty itself can generate volatility,” he told AFP. This year’s El Niño impacts are exacerbated by price shocks caused by the war in Iran, which have raised the cost of fuel and fertiliser for farmers and impacted household spending globally. “For vulnerable households, even moderate food price increases can have huge consequences,” said Torero. “Poor families spend a large share of their incomes on food and therefore have limited capacity to absorb price shocks and spikes,” he added. The consequences can include reduced food consumption, poorer quality diets and “ultimately, increased food insecurity and malnutrition,” he said. In September, the FAO said it had received just one-fifth of the $202 million it requested to prepare for an El Niño-linked food crisis in 22 high-risk countries. nigeria.title: 2027: Tinubu will win, he has no competition — Orji Kalu
nigeria.description: Former Abia State Governor and Senator representing Abia North, Orji Uzor Kalu, has expressed confidence that President Bola Tinubu will win re-election in 2027, declaring that the President has no serious political challenger. Kalu made the prediction on Monday during an appearance on Arise PrimeTime, the flagship evening current affairs programme of Arise News Television, where he defended Tinubu’s economic reforms and declared that Nigeria’s economy had stabilised. The former Senate Chief Whip, who chairs the Senate Committee on the South East Development Commission, also defended the administration against criticism over the economic hardship associated with its policies. He argued that Tinubu had stabilised the economy at the macroeconomic level, saying the major challenge now was to translate that progress into improved living conditions for households and businesses. “President Tinubu has been able to stabilise this economy on the macro level. What we are battling now, having stabilised the economy on the macro level, is the micro level,” he said. Kalu said the administration’s next priority should be to boost agricultural production, improve security and create an enabling environment for manufacturers to access raw materials and increase production capacity. Acknowledging the economic difficulties facing Nigerians, he maintained that the country was beginning to experience greater economic predictability, arguing that reforms often come with temporary hardships. He also credited Tinubu with improving Nigeria’s international economic relations, saying the country was increasingly attracting the attention of foreign investors. On the 2027 presidential election, the senator dismissed the opposition’s chances, insisting that Tinubu would secure another four-year term. “President Tinubu will win. President Tinubu has no competition. The APC’s electoral strength goes beyond the personality of the President. The ruling party enjoys a broad political structure and substantial grassroots support across the country. “What we are seeing on social media is not what is on the ground. Our party is very huge, and the supporters of that party are large. We have huge numbers of people supporting this party,” he said. Kalu added that APC lawmakers and other political stakeholders were already mobilising to consolidate the party’s electoral strength in their respective constituencies ahead of the election. He also appealed for political stability, urging Nigerians to prioritise national unity and allow elected presidents to complete their constitutionally permitted terms. “The unity of this country is very important. nigeria.title: I sold heavy weapons internationally – Orji Kalu
nigeria.description: …Says he sold arms to anyone who could buy The Senator representing Abia North, Orji Kalu, has disclosed that he previously engaged in the international trade of heavy weapons, selling arms to buyers in different countries before quitting the business at the insistence of his parents. Kalu made the revelation during an interview on Arise Television on Monday, while discussing his business background and relationships with former and current South African leaders. Asked whether he was an arms dealer, the former Abia State governor answered in the affirmative, saying he stopped after his parents intervened. “Yes, so I stopped because my parents, my mother, my father came and said I must stop, and I stopped,” he said. Asked whether he sold weapons to people who intended to use them to kill others, Kalu dismissed the suggestion, saying his motivation was to make money. “No, no, no, no, no, no. I was selling guns to make money, whether they blow up it’s not my business,” he said. The interviewer subsequently asked whether he supplied weapons to the African National Congress (ANC) during its struggle against apartheid in South Africa. Kalu said he did not restrict his business to the ANC, explaining that he sold weapons to any buyer who could afford them. “No, I was selling to anybody who wants to buy. If you have the money, you want to buy in D.R.C, I sell to you, you want to buy in Namibia, you want to buy…” he said. Asked about the source of the weapons, the senator declined to provide details, saying, “It’s only my business.” The interviewer also questioned how his former arms trade related to Nigeria’s current security challenges and the proliferation of small arms. In response, Kalu clarified that the weapons he traded were not small arms but heavy weapons sold between countries. “No, these are heavy arms that were sold country to country,” he said. Asked specifically whether he sold weapons to Libya under its late leader, Muammar Gaddafi, Kalu said he sold to anyone with the financial capacity to purchase them. “To anybody that had money to buy,” he responded. When the interviewer suggested that his answer meant he had supplied weapons to Gaddafi, Kalu replied, “May his soul rest in peace. He was a good man. If you have money to buy, when I was selling, I would sell to you.” The senator also spoke about his relationships with successive South African presidents, tracing the connections to his friendship with the country’s late former president, Nelson Mandela. He said Mandela introduced him to several South African leaders, including former President Thabo Mbeki and incumbent President Cyril Ramaphosa. According to Kalu, Mandela once told him that Mbeki’s father had contributed more to the anti-apartheid struggle than Ramaphosa’s father. He said the consideration influenced the ANC’s decision to select Mbeki ahead of Ramaphosa as Mandela’s running mate. nigeria.title: 2027: Most Christians we’ve engaged are okay with Muslim-Muslim ticket – Yilwatda
nigeria.description: The National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Nentawe Yilwatda, says most Christians consulted by the party have expressed satisfaction with the Muslim-Muslim presidential ticket of President Bola Tinubu and Vice President Kashim Shettima ahead of the 2027 general elections. Yilwatda said Christians’ initial concerns that the arrangement could marginalise them had not materialised, insisting that their voices remained represented in the administration. The APC chairman stated this during an interview on Channels Television’s Politics Today on Monday. “Most Christians that we’ve engaged and we’ve spoken to them, they are very okay with the Muslim-Muslim ticket,” he said. “The thought and the fear of most Christians was that the Muslim-Muslim ticket may suppress their voices, but their voices are heard loud and clear now.” He also dismissed concerns that Tinubu’s religion had exposed Christians to discrimination or persecution during his three years in office. On questions surrounding the President’s health and fitness to contest the 2027 election, Yilwatda maintained that Tinubu was physically capable of seeking re-election. He also defended the President’s decision not to attend every campaign rally, arguing that his constitutional responsibilities would not allow him to participate in all party engagements. According to him, some government officials have been advised to attend selected rallies to ensure that governance is not affected by campaign activities. On the leadership crisis rocking the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Yilwatda denied allegations that the APC was behind the party’s internal dispute following the Federal High Court judgment invalidating the David Mark-led leadership. He questioned the opposition party’s decision to blame the ruling party over a dispute arising from a legal action instituted by one of its members. The APC chairman further expressed confidence that Tinubu would defeat former Vice President Atiku Abubakar in a free and fair election. He attributed Atiku’s performance in the 2023 presidential election largely to the political structure of the Peoples Democratic Party rather than his personal popularity. “He did not win because of Atiku; he won because of the structure of the PDP. It was the PDP that brought Atiku, not Atiku winning on his own,” Yilwatda said. He also defended FCT Minister Nyesom Wike’s proposed ₦10m reward for councils that deliver their wards for Tinubu in 2027, arguing that the incentive did not constitute vote buying. nigeria.title: Edo LGA orders daily bush surveillance ahead of Yuletide
nigeria.description: By Kingsley Omonobi The Chairman of Etsako East Local Government Area of Edo State, Rt. Hon. Sunny Ekpetika Ekpeson, has directed vigilante groups to intensify daily surveillance and comb bushes and forests across the area ahead of the Christmas and New Year celebrations. Ekpeson, who is also the Edo State Chairman of the Association of Local Governments of Nigeria (ALGON), gave the directive during an emergency security meeting with vigilante leaders and coordinators to address security concerns ahead of the festive season. A statement issued on Monday, November 9, 2026, by Agbukor Lucky Apeakhuye, the chairman’s media aide on Politics and Strategic Development, said the meeting focused on strengthening security operations across Etsako East. According to the statement, Ekpeson directed vigilante operatives to conduct daily surveillance and thoroughly comb bushes, forests and identified security flashpoints to prevent criminal elements from using remote locations as hideouts. The chairman warned that kidnapping, killings, cult-related activities, violence and other criminal acts would not be tolerated anywhere in the local government area. He also charged security coordinators to strengthen intelligence gathering, improve collaboration among their teams and ensure adequate security coverage across communities throughout the festive period. Those at the meeting included the Vice Chairman, Comrade Charles Aloaye Dagana; Secretary to the Local Government, Dr. Samuel Oshiole Enaboakpe; and Chief Adolphus Oshole Osimi, General Officer Commanding of the Agenebode Zonal Vigilante Command, who oversees security operations across villages in the Weppa-Wanno axis. Other vigilante coordinators also attended the meeting. The statement said Ekpeson reiterated that the protection of lives and property remained a priority of his administration, urging security operatives to remain vigilant, proactive and responsive to distress calls. He further charged vigilante leaders to ensure that the directives translated into concrete action, saying he would not want reports of kidnapping, killings, cult-related violence or other criminal activities across the local government. The meeting, according to the statement, formed part of the council’s measures to strengthen security and ensure peaceful Christmas and New Year celebrations in Etsako East. nigeria.title: Dollar to Naira exchange rate today, November 10, 2026
nigeria.description: The Nigerian naira traded with modest movements across both official and parallel foreign exchange markets on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as market participants weighed ongoing liquidity management by the Central Bank of Nigeria against persistent demand for foreign currency. At the official Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market (NFEM), the United States dollar exchanged at an average rate of ₦1,346.51. The official window recorded early trading activity holding within a narrow band between ₦1,343.35 and ₦1,347.32 per dollar, maintaining the relative stability seen over recent trading sessions. Meanwhile, activities in the parallel market showed the dollar trading between ₦1,410 and ₦1,430 for buying and selling transactions depending on location and local currency dealer. The figures reflect an unofficial market premium of approximately ₦64 to ₦83 per dollar over the NFEM spot rate. Financial analysts note that the mild divergence between official rate outcomes and informal channels continues to reflect spot demand from small-scale importers and individual retail buyers seeking prompt foreign currency access outside primary banking channels. Overall market conditions remain anchored by broader foreign reserve levels and regular clearing of foreign trade obligations. nigeria.title: Asaba rally death: Okada, Keke operators offer police evidence
nigeria.description: By Egufe Yafugborhi ASABA — Commercial motorcycle and tricycle operators in Delta State have offered to provide video footage and other relevant evidence to assist the police in identifying and prosecuting those responsible for the alleged killing of Chinaza Sunday during Saturday’s political violence in Asaba. The operators, under the Commercial Motorcycles and Tricycles Operators Association (COMTOA), made the offer on Monday during a protest at the Delta State Police Command headquarters, where they demanded justice for the deceased, whom they identified as a member of their association. Addressing the police on behalf of the association, a member of its Board of Trustees, Prince Okeoghene Miller Kingsley, said Chinaza was carrying out his legitimate business when he was allegedly killed. “The young man that was murdered was at his duty post carrying out his legitimate duty, where he met his untimely death. “We want to believe that we have confidence in the Nigerian Police that they will do justice to this issue and those persons should be brought to book,” he said. Kingsley said the association was prepared to assist investigators with video recordings, relevant information and details of individuals allegedly connected with the incident. He also dismissed suggestions that the deceased or members of the association were involved in criminal activities or political thuggery. “Chinaza has not been an armed robber. He has not been a thug or a political thug. Everybody you are seeing here is going about our lawful duties. Nobody here is a thug,” he declared. Defending the political rights of commercial transport operators, Kingsley said members were free to associate with political parties and movements of their choice. “Everybody here has the right to belong to anybody he likes to belong to because there is freedom of association, which includes lawful assembly,” he added. Responding, the Deputy Commissioner of Police, Administration, Philip Adejo, acknowledged receipt of the protesters’ petition and assured them that the command would investigate the killing. “We have received your petition. Sometimes self-help can become a serious problem. We sympathise with you; go home and rest because you will see results. It is not going to be like other situations,” Adejo said. He urged the association’s leadership to provide credible information that could assist the investigation. “Your leaders can meet us, and if you have any strong information concerning this, you can come to us so that we can iron it out together,” he added. The protest followed violence on Saturday, November 7, along Nnebisi Road, Asaba, during a procession organised by the Obidient/OK Movement in support of Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigerian Democratic Congress (NDC). nigeria.title: FG unveils N70bn plan to tackle Noma
nigeria.description: By Chidinma Chukwu, Abuja The Federal Government has unveiled a N70bn National Oral Health Strategic Plan for 2026–2030 to improve access to dental care, address the burden of oral diseases and eliminate Noma as a public health problem. The five-year plan is designed to expand preventive and curative oral health services, improve early detection and treatment of Noma, strengthen the dental workforce and integrate oral healthcare into primary healthcare services across the 774 local government areas. The Minister of State for Health and Social Welfare, Dr Iziaq Adekunle Salako, announced the initiative on Monday in Abuja during the commemoration of National Noma Day and National Oral Health Day. According to a statement by the ministry’s Assistant Director, Information and Public Relations, Ado Bako, Salako said the initiative aligned with President Bola Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda, which prioritises the health and wellbeing of Nigerians. He described oral health as a critical component of Universal Health Coverage, saying it should no longer be neglected in the country’s healthcare delivery system. Expressing concern over Nigeria’s burden of Noma, particularly in the North-West and North-East, the minister described the disease as preventable but devastating, with the potential to cause severe facial disfigurement, disability and death, especially among malnourished children. He said the World Health Organisation’s recognition of Noma as a Neglected Tropical Disease in 2023 marked a significant milestone in global efforts to combat the condition. Salako disclosed that the Federal Ministry of Health had integrated Noma surveillance into the Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response system, while intensifying efforts to improve early detection and referral through primary healthcare facilities. He added that frontline health workers, traditional healers and traditional birth attendants had been trained in 19 states to identify early signs of Noma and other oral diseases and facilitate prompt referrals for treatment. Highlighting gaps in oral healthcare delivery, the minister said more than 80 per cent of Nigerians had never visited a dentist, while two out of every three children were living with untreated dental caries. He further disclosed that Nigeria had approximately one dentist for every 38,000 people, compared with the World Health Organisation’s recommended ratio of one dentist to 7,500 people. To address the challenges, Salako said the government was strengthening the integration of oral healthcare into primary healthcare through the Sector-Wide Approach and the Basic Health Care Provision Fund to improve access to affordable and quality services. He also announced that the Federal Executive Council had approved the National Centre for Oral Health Establishment Bill 2026 and forwarded it to the National Assembly for consideration. nigeria.title: Three Nigerians arrested in India over immigration status
nigeria.description: Three Nigerians have been arrested in Delhi, India, for allegedly residing in the country without valid immigration documents. The Times of India reported on Sunday that the Delhi Police arrested the men during a verification exercise in Dwarka, southwest Delhi, on October 31. The report, which cited police officials, identified the suspects as Bartholomew Iloegbunem, Konan Okocha, also known as Konan Brice Kousaai, and Ndubuisi Nwabufor. According to the report, the three men were unable to produce documents authorising their stay in India when questioned by the police. They were subsequently presented before the Foreigners Regional Registration Office and transferred to the Sewa Sadan detention centre in Lampur. The arrests followed a police verification drive targeting foreign nationals in the area, the newspaper reported. nigeria.title: China Diaries: An Emperor, 8,000 Soldiers and a Lesson for Nigeria!
nigeria.description: I came looking for ancient soldiers and left thinking about Nigeria’s tourism potential! One of the things I was particularly looking forward to during my visit to China was seeing the famous Terracotta Warriors in Xi’an. I had read about them, seen pictures and, of course, watched films inspired by the mysteries of ancient China. But nothing quite prepares you for the experience of standing in front of thousands of life-sized soldiers who have been buried underground for more than 2,000 years. And what an experience it was! For anyone who has watched Hollywood’s The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor, you may remember the mysterious army of clay soldiers that comes alive. Well, I finally got to see the real thing. Thankfully, none of them came alive while I was there! But standing in those enormous exhibition halls, surrounded by thousands of soldiers, horses and chariots arranged in military formation, I couldn’t help wondering what must have gone through the minds of the people who created this extraordinary army. The story takes us back to around 221 BC, when Qin Shi Huang became the first emperor to unify China. Like many powerful rulers of his time, he was obsessed with immortality and the idea of continuing his reign beyond death. His solution was to build an entire underground army to protect him in the afterlife. Think about that! While some people prepare for retirement, this emperor was preparing for eternity, complete with his own military formation! The scale of the project is difficult to comprehend. Thousands of life-sized clay soldiers, horses and chariots were painstakingly created. And what makes the discovery even more fascinating is that the soldiers are not identical. They have different facial features, hairstyles, uniforms and expressions. They look like real individuals, each with a distinct identity and military rank. Then comes another remarkable twist. For over two thousand years, this enormous army remained hidden beneath the earth until 1974, when some local farmers digging a well stumbled upon fragments of what would become one of the greatest archaeological discoveries in modern history. Imagine going out to dig a well and discovering an entire army! I wonder what the conversation was like that evening when they returned home. Today, the site is recognised globally as one of the greatest archaeological treasures in the world and is popularly described as the Eighth Wonder of the World. UNESCO designated the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor a World Heritage Site in 1987. But beyond the fascinating history, what struck me most was what China has done with this discovery. This is where the story becomes particularly interesting for Nigeria. China has not simply uncovered an ancient treasure and left it to gather dust. It has invested in archaeological research, conservation, restoration, museum infrastructure, visitor facilities and tourism development. The preservation work itself is remarkable. nigeria.title: Oluwo seeks Yoruba language as medium for teaching science
nigeria.description: By Shina Abubakar, Osogbo The Oluwo of Iwo, Oba Abdulrosheed Akanbi, has called for the development and promotion of Yoruba language as a medium of instruction for academic subjects, including Physics and other specialised courses. The monarch made the call on Monday during the 2026 Odun Olodumare celebration and his 11th coronation anniversary at his palace in Iwo, Osun State. Oba Akanbi said Yoruba had the capacity to serve as a language of instruction across different academic disciplines if deliberate efforts were made to develop and expand its use. “Normally, I prefer to speak my Yoruba language. I want to upgrade the Yoruba language so that we can use it to teach Physics and all kinds of subjects and courses in the educational system,” he said. The traditional ruler also advocated the preservation and modernisation of Yoruba culture, particularly the reform of traditions he said promoted violence. While praising the richness of Yoruba heritage, he stressed the need to preserve its positive aspects while addressing practices that could encourage violence. “When it comes to culture, I want a culture that is free of violence. I accept all Yoruba cultures and traditions, but those that need modifications, particularly traditions that promote violence, must be addressed. “It is not that I totally reject them, but I understand that change takes time,” he said. The monarch also announced a N5 million empowerment scheme for at least 100 residents of Iwo, with each beneficiary expected to receive N50,000. He said the beneficiaries would be drawn from different segments of the community, including members of the royal institution, princes, chiefs, the Muslim community, traditional initiates and ordinary residents. According to him, beneficiaries will be selected randomly rather than through a predetermined process. The 2026 Odun Olodumare celebration also attracted members of different religious groups to the palace, where they offered prayers and praises to God for the monarch, his subjects, Iwo town and the country. nigeria.title: US-mediated talks with Russia and Ukraine to start in Abu Dhabi
nigeria.description: Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States will hold talks in Abu Dhabi Tuesday on ending Europe’s worst conflict since World War II in the first such meeting in more than nine months, as another winter of war approaches. Europe – alarmed by US President Donald Trump floating a deal with Moscow on European security ahead of the talks – will also send representatives to Abu Dhabi. Trump has pushed for an end to the Russia-Ukraine war since returning to power, but previous talks produced no breakthroughs and the process became sidelined by the US-Israeli war against Iran. Europe and Ukraine fear the United States will force a deal on Kyiv that would amount to a de-facto capitulation, with Trump appearing to pivot towards Moscow this year. Moscow’s invasion of Ukraine has killed hundreds of thousands, displaced millions and has dragged on for 56 months, with the Kremlin showing no sign of backing down. Trump hinted Ukraine will have to give up land ahead of the talks, saying: “They’re going to end up with a little bit different shape, Ukraine.” Russia occupies large swathes of Ukraine but, while its troops have grinded westwards, they have not been able to seize the whole of the Donetsk region. Moscow demands Kyiv surrender the parts of the region it still controls, vowing it will otherwise press on with its offensive. Ukraine – which for more than 4.5 years has resisted a far larger invading army at a huge human cost – has ruled out such a withdrawal. Russia pummelled Ukraine in the run-up to the talks and carried out one of its deadliest strikes yet – with Kyiv saying 55 people were killed in a frontline village as they queued for humanitarian aid. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the intensified strikes were part of Moscow’s strategy of “putting pressure on Ukraine’s position” at the negotiations. Russia’s Vladimir Putin, who launched the war in February 2022, has repeatedly refused broader ceasefire offers and face-to-face talks with Zelensky. Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner and special envoy Steve Witkoff will gather the enemy sides in Abu Dhabi for the first time since February, when negotiations took place in Geneva. Russia and Ukraine have held several rounds of failed talks during almost five years of war and hopes for peace are low. “We don’t have any particular expectations,” a senior Ukrainian official in Kyiv told AFP. ‘We don’t want Yalta 2.0’ Trump last week floated a “very big agreement” on the war that will “involve all of Europe”, stoking fears Washington would collaborate with Moscow on creating a new European security architecture. Shortly before launching its 2022 invasion, Moscow had issued an ultimatum to the West for NATO to rollback troops from Eastern Europe. nigeria.title: Rivers community that forbids female dogs explains tradition to NYSC members
nigeria.description: By Davies Iheamnachor — APARA The people of Ekinobo in Apara Kingdom, Ikwerre ethnic nationality of Rivers State, have raised the alarm over the growing disregard for their customs, including a longstanding prohibition against keeping female dogs in the community. •His Royal Majesty Eze Ohna Apara Kingdom, Gift Eziwhuo Johnson (middle), flanked by corps members. The community, located in Obio/Akpor Local Government Area, said urbanization, the influx of strangers and increasing Western influence had contributed to the erosion of its cultural heritage and traditional practices. This came as the Paramount Ruler of Apara Kingdom, His Royal Majesty, Eze Gift Eziwhuo Johnson, Eze Ohna Apara IV, and the Chiefs-in-Council hosted members of the Culture and Tourism Community Development Service (CDS) of the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) to a cultural orientation programme on the customs, traditions and laws of the Apara people. The corps members embarked on the visit as part of an initiative to familiarise themselves with the cultural values of their host communities, understand local traditions and avoid practices capable of offending indigenous sensibilities. The visit also provided an opportunity for the traditional institution to seek stronger collaboration with the NYSC in promoting mutual understanding, preserving cultural heritage and fostering peaceful relationships. NYSC members visit Speaking during the visit, the leader of the Culture and Tourism CDS group, Dominic Umoh, said the initiative was designed to expose corps members to the cultural values of their host communities and preserve such knowledge for future generations. A 13F is a snapshot, not a trading diary. The company bought another 1,036 bitcoin last week for $81.9 million at an average of $79,012, a Monday 8-K filing and company release show, lifting its treasury to 850,364 BTC acquired for $64.16 billion at an average of $75,456. Choosing a colour or designing a pattern is only one of the processes. Each material carries details on how it was gathered, prepared, and transformed, which Malunga is incorporating into contemporary fashion. “My dyes are mainly extracted from plants such as mnyii and hibiscus. Although I also use many other plants, including tubers, that have properties suitable for dye extraction. I love hibiscus not only for its petals, which produce beautiful dyes, but also for its tea.” The 37-year-old designer is challenging conventional notions about what defines a fashion collection and where creative knowledge originates. Through her clothing business, GANU, she transforms indigenous materials and skills into clothes and accessories, demonstrating how knowledge passed down through generations can inform modern design, provide opportunities for rural women, and conserve cultural practices. Her method is based on teachings learned from her late maternal grandmother, Ngatsha Nkatha, who resided in Tsholotsho, a rural district in Zimbabwe. During the school vacations, Malunga and her siblings traveled from Bulawayo to visit grandma, witnessing as she turned sisal, sedge, and reeds into winnowing baskets. “When I was a child, I often visited my grandmother in the village with my siblings. She was very dexterous with her fingers, and that passion eventually became mutual.” Malunga started experimenting with fashion in her teens before launching Ganu in 2013. The name is derived from iganu, the Ndebele term for marula fruit, and represents her connection to local resources and African identity. Her creations blend basketry, crocheting, batik, and beadwork with natural dyes, leather, and other locally produced materials. For Malunga, the importance of these materials goes beyond their appearance. Bamboo, sisal, reeds, and sedge are used in basketry, and she breeds Angora goats for their fur, which she straightens and dyes to make garments. Cowhide obtained from local abattoirs is softened in a tannery before being mixed into leather designs. “I keep Angora goats for the fur needed in garment production. However, for raw materials such as cowhide, I usually source these from local abattoirs while sisal and tree barks are either harvested by me or sometimes extracted by colleagues I work with, who are based in the rural areas.” Desmond Ntini , a cultural entrepreneur based in Bulawayo, sees Malunga’s work as part of a broader shift in how African history is perceived and used. ” Malunga is redefining the fashion industry by blending traditional African influences with contemporary creativity. entertainment.title: Israel Olaleye: What Selling Land Taught Me About How Nigerians Think About Money
entertainment.description: In 2021, I graduated from the University of Ibadan with a degree in Mathematics. I thought my life would be about numbers on a whiteboard. I did not know it would become about numbers in people’s bank accounts, and the fears, hopes and contradictions that sit behind them. By mid-2023, I had taken a job selling real estate. I started at the very bottom, as a sales development representative: the person who makes the first call, sends the message and follows up when nobody replies. Today, I manage a sales team. Somewhere between then and now, I stopped seeing real estate as a business of land and buildings. I started seeing it as a mirror. Put a property in front of a Nigerian, and you will learn, very quickly, how they think about money. Here is some of what that mirror has shown me: A prospect once told me, with complete confidence, “I have my money ready for the land.” We fixed an inspection. We walked the site together under the afternoon sun, red earth on our shoes. Then, standing on the plot, the prospect asked if they could pay next year. I was not angry. I understood. Saying “I am ready” feels good. Being ready is different. It means you have decided what the money is for, and you are willing to let it go. I have seen versions of that moment many times. The client who books an inspection for 2 pm and is still not there at 4 pm. The person who asks for options, receives ten properties that match exactly what they requested, and replies, “Do you have something else?” The buyer who is ready until it is time to decide, and then needs three more months to think. The one who disappeared after asking for a price came back after the price went up, and asked for the old price. For a long time, these moments frustrated me. But they taught me that most people do not have a money problem. They have a decision problem. We are a generation that earns, spends, plans and postpones, often all at the same time. You can earn a lot and still not be wealthy One idea I keep returning to is that you can earn twenty million naira a year and still not be wealthy. Income is what comes in. Wealth is what stays and grows. sports.description: AS Roma set key condition to sign out-of-favour Barcelona defender in January It is known that Barcelona are considering the possibility of selling Alejandro Balde during the January transfer window, with AS Roma exploring a potential deal for the left-back as they look to generate funds for squad reinforcements. On that note, according to Spanish publication SPORT , the Italian club are examining a paid loan with an obligation to buy that would become conditional on qualification for next season’s Champions League. Balde’s situation has attracted attention because Barcelona are assessing their options in the transfer market, with signing a central defender among Flick’s priorities. However, a potential departure is far from straightforward given the Catalan club’s €40 million valuation of the academy graduate. Roma consider conditional purchase option for Balde Roma’s proposed formula is designed to make the operation financially manageable. AS Roma are interested in signing Alejandro Balde. (Photo by Pedro Salado/Getty Images) Rather than paying Barcelona’s full asking price immediately, the Serie A side would initially secure Balde’s services on loan before triggering a purchase obligation if they qualify for the Champions League. Such an arrangement would also give Barcelona an opportunity to generate revenue through a future permanent transfer. However, the financial demands remain a significant obstacle, as Barcelona value the defender highly, meaning Roma would need to commit considerable resources to complete the operation in January itself. Juventus and Premier League clubs join the race Notably, Roma are not the only club monitoring Balde’s availability, as Juventus have also been following the defender, with their interest potentially influenced by uncertainty surrounding Andrea Cambiaso’s future in Turin. The competition extends to England , where Liverpool, Aston Villa, Manchester United, Manchester City and Tottenham have all been linked with the Barcelona full-back. Monaco are another potential destination. Barcelona value Alejandro Balde at €40 million. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) However, the financial structure of a potential transfer could determine which clubs remain realistic candidates. Barcelona value Balde at around €40 million and would prefer a permanent sale, although they are prepared to consider a loan arrangement that guarantees future income. Barcelona to use Balde’s departure to fund January signing Understandably, Balde’s possible departure is also connected to Barcelona’s recruitment plans. It is known that Flick wants additional defensive reinforcement, particularly a left-footed centre-back who could strengthen his options during the second half of the season. Hence, selling an academy graduate would provide Barcelona with an opportunity to generate transfer income while potentially creating additional room within their wage structure.

It’s an idea that makes little to no sense for the Rams, prompted by an especially bad quarterback performance during a standalone game on Monday night. Stafford isn’t having his best season and Los Angeles isn’t even guaranteed a playoff spot at this point, but nothing this franchise has done would indicate they’re interested in such a hard reset. sports.title: 'Grim day brings the R-word into focus'
sports.description: [BBC] Saturday's game at Cardiff ended with a mass brawl as the players, including some of Burnley's substitutes, clashed on the pitch. They completely lost their cool, it was embarrassing and will probably result in an FA charge and possibly a club fine. Having just watched their side capitulate from 4-1 up to 5-4 down inside the final half an hour, the supporters who travelled to Cardiff, and those following back home, were then subjected to that reaction. The lack of discipline and respect shown during those final few moments of the game was a dreadful look on a grim day for the club. The contrast from this Burnley side to the one that won promotion under Scott Parker could not be greater, and it's not just about the numbers. Although, the numbers are worth looking at. Just 16 goals conceded during that promotion season. It's now 31 goals against this time round already. They've taken the lead in 10 of their 15 league games and only won once. They've lost 23 points from winning positions. Burnley have gone from having a team that was relatable and likeable, that ran and worked hard and represented the club, to one that has forgotten how to win and has no way of dealing with adversity. The squad looks bloated, poorly balanced and far too injury-prone and with too many who probably don't want to be there. It's been 26 years since Burnley last played outside England's top two divisions. Could the club cope with a relegation to League One?
